text:
claire: FYI support flagged a couple onboarding customers where a 429 during token refresh led to duplicate side-effects. not widespread but high pain.
otto: can you paste a sanitized snippet?
claire:
```
2026-03-25T08:11:02Z req=aa11 status=429 retry-after=0.3
2026-03-25T08:11:02Z sdk retried req=aa11 idempotency_key=none
2026-03-25T08:11:03Z server processed create_subscription idempotency_key=none
```
otto: classic. i want to propose something slightly different from idempotency-key-only: add a lightweight Replay-Cookie concept that SDKs can set only when a retry is the result of an auth refresh. cookie is short (8-12 chars) HMAC of a random nonce + SDK short-version so servers can dedupe transient replays without storing full payloads.
noah: interesting. how is that different from a nonce header?
otto: nonce is fine, but Replay-Cookie is intentionally low-cardinality and reversible only by server HMAC key so we avoid customer ids. server keeps seen-cookie set TTL=30s and treats duplicates as replays for mutating endpoints. advantage: no global idempotency on every call, only when replay-risk is detected (during refresh).
claire: love targeted approach. also propose sample apps enable autoIdempotency for onboarding flows (opt-out) and SDKs expose opts {autoIdempotency:false/true, replayCookieTtlSec:30, sampleRate:0.01}. docs should call out streaming/generation exceptions.
noah: backoff defaults? we should honor Retry-After and use exp backoff with full jitter. suggest base=150ms, max=25s, safeReplayWindow=30s.
otto: agreed. telemetry: add `X-Rw-Replay-Candidate: 1` only when replay-cookie header is attached so infra can index boolean. also `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v1;sdk=py;tag=replay` only when sampling for deeper debugging. no PII.
claire: pseudocode for sample apps:
```js
// only for mutating onboarding calls
if (duringAuthRefresh && shouldAttachReplayCookie()) {
  headers['Replay-Cookie'] = generateHmacShort(nonce, sdkVersion)
  headers['X-Rw-Replay-Candidate'] = '1'
  if (sampleDecide()) headers['X-Rw-Sample-Info'] = 'v1;sdk=node;tag=replay-debug'
}
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = opts.idempotencyKey || (autoIdempotency ? uuidv4() : undefined)
await retryWithBackoff({baseMs:150, maxMs:25000, jitter:'full', honorRetryAfter:true})
```
noah: action items: 1) devex: RFC proposing Replay-Cookie + sample headers + SDK parity (assignee: @claire). 2) infra/runtime: accept `X-Rw-Replay-Candidate` boolean and implement short seen-cookie TTL dedupe (owner: infra). 3) SDKs: add parity flags and sample-app updates. 4) docs: explicit streaming exception and onboarding guidance.
dev-bot: created issue devex-2044: "replay-cookie + sample telemetry RFC" (assignee: @claire) :spiral_note_pad:
claire: i'll draft RFC with privacy checklist and compatibility plan for older SDKs (servers treat absent headers as legacy behavior). will post link when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
